amendments.body: The patch still does not implement the requested geometry-scaled startup defaults. `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:672-708` still leaves filter flow at a hard-coded `200.0` lph when enabled and only toggles heater enable/setpoint or authored shrimp counts, `crates/tank_scenarios/src/lib.rs:785-807` still seeds every plant guild at a fixed `5.0` g, and `crates/tank_core/src/types/hardware.rs:64-90` still defaults the heater to `50.0` W. Since the diff only touches `tank_core` alkalinity/budget files, the acceptance criteria around geometry-aware filter/heater/plant/stocking scaling remain unmet.
amendments.rationale: This bead is specifically about scenario/default scaling with tank geometry; the current change set is off-scope and leaves the existing fixed defaults in place.

amendments.body: The new alkalinity budget path is not protected the same way the existing nitrogen/carbon paths are. `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:845-868` still enforces tracked-budget residuals only for nitrogen and carbon, and the tracked helper coverage in `crates/tank_core/tests/budget_helpers.rs:128-135` still only exercises N/C/O. As committed, a regression in the new meq accounting can slip through both CI and the runtime tick guard unless you add either an alkalinity guard or committed regression tests (the only alkalinity-focused test file currently present is untracked).
amendments.rationale: The diff expands `BudgetDelta`/`BudgetTotals`/`budget_helpers` to carry alkalinity, but it leaves the verification story incomplete, which is a significant maintainability and correctness risk for future changes.

amendments.body: The new nitrogen-cycle trace metric is internally inconsistent in nitrite-accumulating hours. `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:12-23` exposes `total_mg_n_nitrified`, but `crates/tank_core/src/systems/nitrogen_cycle.rs:343-346` computes it as `nob_step + comammox_step`, excluding TAN that AOB oxidized only to nitrite. `crates/tank_core/src/engine.rs:229-239` then logs that value as `nitrogen_cycle.total_n_nitrified_mg`, so an AOB-only or NOB-limited tick can report zero nitrification while `alk_consumed_meq` is positive. That makes the new diagnostic misleading for the exact cycling edge cases this work is trying to illuminate.
amendments.rationale: This does not break simulation state, but it does make the newly added tracing output incorrect in common immature-cycle scenarios.

payload.summary: Reviewed the tracked diff and the relevant `tank_core`/scenario files. Main findings: the submitted changes do not address the geometry-scaling task itself, the new alkalinity accounting is only partially verified, and the added nitrification trace metric under-reports partial TAN oxidation.
